meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会持续盯住一个 PR，直到它可以合并：反复检查评论、审查和 CI 状态，修复真正的问题并推送，全部解决后才停下，并汇报提交号和检查结果等证据。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit、monitor 或持续检查某个 PR 的评论、审查和 CI，直到所有可处理问题解决时触发。

say.text: 盯住这个 PR，直到可以合并。
say.note: Claude 会持续检查评论、审查和 CI，直到全部解决。

say.text: 监控 #123 的 review 线程，有问题就修。
say.note: Claude 会列出未解决线程，修复后将其解决。

say.text: 帮我盯到合并，每轮检查后报告进度。
say.note: Claude 会定期轮询，并汇报最新状态和剩余问题。

howto.what_en: Claude will keep watching a PR until it can merge: repeatedly checks comments, reviews, and CI, fixes real issues and pushes, stops only when clean, then reports latest commit SHA and check results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a pull request's comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Keep an eye on this PR until it can merge.
say_en.note: Claude watches comments, reviews, CI until resolved.

say_en.text: Monitor review threads on #123 and fix any issues.
say_en.note: Claude lists open threads and resolves them after fixing.

say_en.text: Watch until merge, report progress after each check.
say_en.note: Claude polls and reports status and remaining issues.
